levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن عبد الله بن المغيرة

notes: «حدثني أبي» : bare «أبي» is a relation link; the three co-transmitters share one level
the Imam «أبو عبد الله» is named in the words after the chain, so he is the last link (owner ruling 2); he answers her question, which settles it (rule 11)
«(ع)», «(ص)» and «رحمهم الله» are honorifics, left out; «الحسين بن علي (ع)» in the story is not a link
